Version 1.6.0

- Clarified skill usage scope; added prominent warning about potential external tool invocation.
- Updated when_to_use triggers for clearer context coverage.
- Expanded related_skills with qa-test-reporting and qa-testability-advocacy.
- Introduced traceability requirements: each observation gets a unique ID and links to test case ID.
- Added explicit quantification of observation depth requirements.
- Updated categories metadata for clarity.
- Appended a new, focused checklist to aid execution and reporting.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

- Introduced version metadata and structured input/output formats in SKILL.md for clearer integration.
- Added "核心原则"和信号深度分级要求，涵盖不同场景复杂度下的观察标准。
- 增加异常处理引导和error_recovery_guidance字段，提升异常流程指导与报告一致性。
- 调整“应用场景”与“自检清单”内容，使观察流程更加聚焦实际问题发现与报告。
- 移除skill-card.md，合并维护点到SKILL.md并简化内容结构。

- skill-card.md 文件已移除，内容全部集中至 SKILL.md。
- SKILL.md 精简了描述，更突出六路信号观测模型，弱化了冗余用语。
- 保留了原有六路信号模型、观察清单、异常信号及举例，未新增新功能。
- 触发条件与用户场景描述未变，技能核心未修改。
- 文档结构更简洁，便于理解和查找。

- Expanded and clarified the skill description with more scenarios and keywords, improving discoverability.
- Enhanced the "when_to_use" trigger list with additional relevant phrases.
- Added an Overview and Guidelines sections for more structured usage.
- Introduced practical examples for typical test execution situations and exception tracing.
- No change to the core six-route signal model or observation checklists.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.

- Added detailed 六路信号 (Six Signals) model for QA test execution observation: 功能, 性能, 日志, 数据, 前端, 依赖.
- Introduced clear steps and checklists for pre-execution, in-execution, and post-execution QA observation.
- Specified abnormal (异常) signals for each observation route to help users quickly identify issues.
- Outlined connections with upstream (场景树/边界) and downstream (Bug分析/报告) QA skills.
- Improved guidance for raising testing quality by standardizing observation and reporting formats.
